import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource

def cfg(**kw):
    c = {"early":False,"overlap":"reject","buffer_packets":16,"idle_ms":0,
         "max_streams_bidi":1024,"max_streams_uni":1024,"max_stream_data":65536,
         "max_data":4611686018427387903,"crypto_limit":65536,"sent":{"I":[],"H":[],"A":[]}}
    c.update(kw); return c

traces = []; tf=0; tp=0; te=0
for ti in range(32):
    events = [{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"}]; te+=1
    t=1; pn=0
    for j in range(32):   # data frames
        fr=[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":j*2048,"data_hex":"ab"*2048}]
        events.append({"t":t,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"A","pn":pn,"auth":True,"frames":fr}]})
        pn+=1;t+=1;tf+=1;tp+=1;te+=1
    while te < 20000-32*31 and len(events) < 625 and tf < 60000:
        fr=[{"type":"PING"}]*3
        events.append({"t":t,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"A","pn":pn,"auth":True,"frames":fr}]})
        pn+=1;t+=1;tf+=3;tp+=1;te+=1
    while len(events) < 625:
        events.append({"t":t,"op":"tick"}); t+=1; te+=1
    traces.append({"id":"t%d"%ti,"config":cfg(),"events":events})
doc={"version":1,"traces":traces}
raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print("bytes",len(raw),"frames",tf,"pkts",tp,"events",te)
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/app/submission/entry.py"],input=raw,capture_output=True)
ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)

out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("error" if "error" in out else "ok", len(out.get("results",[])))
if "results" in out:
    r=out["results"][0]; print("pkts",len(r["packets"]), "cryptoA", r["crypto"][2]["highest"], r["crypto"][2]["contiguous_hex"][:20])
